title: ECDH P-384: SHA-256 for HKDF is Phase 1 placeholder — needs tracking
description: wolfssl_ecdh_agree uses WC_SHA256 for HKDF regardless of curve. Comment says 'Phase 1: curve-agnostic'. SP 800-56C Rev 2 Table 2 recommends hash strength >= curve security level: P-384 (192-bit security) should use SHA-384 or SHA-512, not SHA-256 (128-bit security). When ECDH-P384 is used for anything approaching its design security level, this design gap matters. The 'Phase 1' label indicates this is known but deferred — it needs a beads issue and human_task so it doesn't get forgotten.
